Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for EMRS Bedma PGT History Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the Eklavya Model Residential School Bedma recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is PGT History. This is a contractual position offered by EMRS Bedma.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the PGT History post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the PGT History post in this recruitment drive by Eklavya Model Residential School Bedma.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly without any prior online application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 15 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the PGT History post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is a Post Graduation Degree with B. Ed from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the PGT History position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 35000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the PGT History post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the PGT History post will be through a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Eklavya Model Residential School Bedma located?
faq.answer: Eklavya Model Residential School Bedma is located in Kondagaon, Chhattisgarh, with the pincode 494331.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant certificates as mentioned in the notification.
